column9: Islay edition of the Regional Malts range, sourced from Ardbeg/Bowmore/Bruichladdich/Bunnahabhain/Caol Ila and others per retailer listings. Producer's own Islay product page confirms region=Islay but does not itself state a ppm/peat level; multiple independent retailers additionally sell a "Clan Denny Heavily Peated"/"Traditional Islay Blended Malt" SKU consistently reviewed as heavily peated ("smoke bomb"). Baseline row (Highland/Speyside editions) stays none.

Producer's own range page describes a distinct, separately-marketed "medium peated" collection using Belgian malt smoked with Scottish peat (35ppm per press coverage), for "those who love smoked single malt whisky" -- distinct from this batch's Shiraz/Palo Cortado cask-finish samples, which stay none.
